items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One src/main.zig of about 133KB. Process functions are monolithic, with deep nesting (for/switch inside while inside if inside loops). yuvToRgbPair switch arms are copy-pasted per format. .zig-cache and zig-out binaries were committed.

items.name: Robustness
